# Infrastructure acceptance fixtures

Existing `TestT18ActualDiagnosticPlacement` and
`TestT202ActualHybridTriggerAndSnapshot` compose production JetStream consumers,
actual owner HTTP clients and PostgreSQL repositories. T18 produces immutable
placement decisions from real Student diagnostic completion. T202 commits a
durable inbox/coalesced queue and a snapshot job from genuine Student
postcommit evidence. Neither proof invokes model generation/evaluation.

Root owns fresh database setup, migrations, finite owner providers, broker
lifecycle and retained fixture cleanup. The tests never reset shared streams or
stores. Apply Planner forward migrations 001–022. Student requires its owner
migrations through 032; Course uses its owner migration selection through 053.

Historical frozen fixture guards remain the default. A root-owned alternate
fixture requires all of:

- `INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_ISOLATED_FIXTURE=true`
- `INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_POSTGRES_HOST=127.0.0.1`
- `INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_POSTGRES_PORT`: the root-owned loopback port
- `INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_POSTGRES_SERVER_IP`: independently attested backend IP,
  checked through `inet_server_addr()` before fixture writes
- `INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_PLANNER_DATABASE_NAME=infra_acceptance_planner_<run>_test`
- `INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_NATS_PORT`: the dedicated root-owned loopback broker port

Existing DSNs must match that exact host/port/database, include a user and
use `sslmode=disable`. Broker URLs must be the exact explicit loopback port,
without credentials, paths, query strings or fragments. Private owner clients
in these proofs disable inherited HTTP proxies.

Run diagnostic acceptance with:

`go test -tags=integration ./cmd/ms-go-learning-planner -run '^TestT18ActualDiagnosticPlacement$' -count=1 -timeout=10m`

Set `T18_ACTUAL_PLACEMENT=true`, `PLANNER_TEST_DATABASE_URL`,
`T18_NATS_URL`, ready artifacts `T18_STUDENT_READY_FILE` and
`T18_COURSE_READY_FILE`, and distinct `T18_STUDENT_TOKEN`,
`T18_STUDENT_PLANNER_TOKEN`, `T18_COURSE_TOKEN`, `T18_COURSE_CATALOG_TOKEN`.
Required fresh `T18_ACTUAL_RESULT_FILE` contains sanitized evidence. Leave browser
completion instrumentation disabled. Root first starts the existing actual
Course curated provider and registered Student diagnostic provider. Course
requires a separate `remediation_t18_course_test` database via
`T18_COURSE_TEST_DATABASE_URL`, `T18_ATTESTED_POSTGRES_HOST`, dedicated Course
credentials and fresh ready/stop/result artifacts. Its canonical `en`/`ru`
language and supported single-choice code-structure references must exist;
the fixture slug must be absent. Named curated questions are owner fixture
inputs, with no AI-authoring claim.

Run planning-state acceptance with:

`go test -tags=integration ./cmd/ms-go-learning-planner -run '^TestT202ActualHybridTriggerAndSnapshot$' -count=1 -timeout=4m`

Set `T202_ACTUAL_HYBRID=true`, `PLANNER_T202_DATABASE_URL`, `T202_NATS_URL`,
`T202_OWNER_READY_FILE`, and the genuine `T202_OWNER_EVENT_FILE` exported by
Student's existing producer proof. Root must launch Student's finite T202
snapshot/production-relay provider first. Optional `T202_PLANNER_RESULT_FILE`
and `PLANNER_T20_SNAPSHOT_FILE` retain private evidence. The latter path must be
absent at provider startup; do not overwrite unrelated artifacts.

Both consumers strictly validate canonical workqueue settings: exact one
subject, file storage, zero expiry, unlimited message count, 1 GiB byte bound,
discard-new, one replica and ten-minute deduplication. Durable consumers use
exact filter/name, deliver-all, explicit ACK, unlimited redelivery, 30-second
ACK wait and one outstanding delivery. ACK follows the immutable placement or
inbox transaction; invalid mismatches terminate and transient errors delay NAK.
The actual proofs cover duplicates, offline accumulation/restart and lost ACK
recovery. T202 separately labels additional burst/outage envelopes as transport
fixtures; they do not pretend to be new official evidence. Protocol-only
publish/fetch/ACK verification remains separate evidence.

A prior protocol-test consumer can compete for a workqueue subject. Use a new
isolated broker with canonical provisioning; preserve prior proof data and
never purge it to make these tests pass. Private readiness/token/body artifacts
must not enter logs. Root stops finite providers through their own stop files.
